meta.title: THE SERVANT'S KEY
meta.subtitle: A MORAL STORY
meta.moral_line: Trust is earned in silence... and rewarded in time.

narration: Some men guard gold. Ezra guarded something worth far more... his word.
For thirty years, he carried the keys to every vault in Lord Ashford's mansion.

narration: While others came and went, Ezra stayed. Polishing silver nobody praised him for.
Trusted with everything. Noticed by no one.

narration: Then one night, a new footman whispered to him: The vault is open.
One handful... and we are free men.

narration: Ezra looked at the gold for a long moment. Then he closed the vault... and locked it.
Freedom bought with stolen gold... is just a nicer cage.

narration: The next morning, Lord Ashford announced that gold was missing. Every servant was called to the hall.
All eyes turned to the man who held the keys. But Ezra stood tall... Truth needs no witness.

narration: Then Lord Ashford smiled... and opened the vault himself. Nothing was gone.
It was a test... and Ezra was the only one who passed.

narration: Years later, on his final night, the old master pressed the keys into Ezra's hands.
The house, the vault, the gold... it belongs to the man who never touched it. Well done, my friend.
Trust is earned in silence... and rewarded in time.
